# Security

Thank you for looking. If you have found something, we would genuinely rather hear it from you.

## Reporting

Email **hello@projectihmr.org** with "security" in the subject line. Please do not open a public
issue for anything that could be exploited before it is fixed.

We will acknowledge within a few days and keep you updated. If you would like credit we will
give it; if you would rather stay anonymous that is completely fine.

## What is in scope

- This repository and its tooling
- The website at projectihmr.org and its API
- Anything that could expose a commenter's email address or other personal data

**That last one matters most to us.** The only personal data this project holds is verified
email addresses and optional phone numbers from people who commented. Protecting those is a
promise we made to them.

## What is not a vulnerability

- A clinical rule being wrong or outdated. That is important, but please raise it as a normal
  issue so it can be discussed openly. See [`rules/`](../rules/)
- A simulation producing a result you disagree with. Also important, also public
- Missing rate limits on something with no security consequence

## A note on scale

Nothing here operates on real patient data, and no part of this project runs in production. If
that ever changes, this policy will change with it and we will say so clearly.
